svg.title: Input ratios by edit scenario
svg.desc: Each cell is native input divided by xnip input. A star marks a native output that was not byte-exact in every repetition.
svg.text: xnip = 1x | tokens | darker = larger ratio (log color scale)
* Native file bytes differ from the task goal. Payload size alone is not an equivalent-outcome saving.
Every cell uses its own same-task xnip denominator. Values are not total agent tokens or billed usage.
Gemini context follows the native prompt; minimal is an executor-accepted alternative. Aider platform follows this run's operating system.
